what.text: This page follows refugees from Moldova living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1120 Moldovan refugees in the United States, 19.2% of all refugees from Moldova.
Germany hosts the most Moldovan refugees, followed by the United States, France and Romania.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Moldova: over Dniestr territory with the PMR in 1992.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2002 to 2006, come long after that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 15 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 8338, at the end of 2006, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
